n6a1c7b5a88.headline: BoC repurchases 520,000 shares under €30 million buyback plan
n6a1c7b5a88.summary: Bank of Cyprus repurchased 520,200 of its ordinary shares between April 4 and April 10, 2025, under its ongoing buyback programme, executed on the Cyprus and Athens exchanges.
n6a1c7b5a88.why: Share buybacks reduce the number of shares outstanding and are a way for banks to return surplus capital to shareholders.

n8d21517372.headline: ANALYSIS: Could Africa still be hard hit by Trump’s tariff tantrum?
n8d21517372.summary: An analysis asks whether Africa could still be hard hit by Trump's reciprocal tariffs, arguing that if imposed they would hit AGOA beneficiaries more than most.
n8d21517372.why: The African Growth and Opportunity Act gives eligible African countries duty-free access to the U.S. market, so changes to it affect their export earnings.

n383b483aaa.headline: UK Economy Grows Faster Than Expected in February as Trump Tariff Threat Looms
n383b483aaa.summary: UK economic growth beat expectations in February, though economists said growth will likely be hampered by U.S. trade policies in the coming months.
n383b483aaa.why: UK GDP data shapes Bank of England rate expectations, gilt yields and sterling, and is a key gauge of the British economy's health.

n65573b710a.headline: Punjab National Bank (PNB) cuts FD interest rates on these tenures: Check details
n65573b710a.summary: Punjab National Bank has revised fixed deposit rates for amounts below Rs 3 crore, following similar moves by other banks. The top rate for general citizens is now 7.10% for a 390-day tenure.
n65573b710a.why: Punjab National Bank is one of India's large state-run lenders, and deposit rate changes signal the broader direction of Indian bank funding costs.

nd540c2ed0c.headline: Germany Says Euro Can Have Stronger Role in Global Trade
nd540c2ed0c.summary: Germany's Finance Minister Joerg Kukies said the European Union has a chance to give the euro stronger weight in global trade. He made the comments in an interview with Bloomberg.
nd540c2ed0c.why: The euro's share of global trade and reserves influences currency demand, trade invoicing and the EU's financial influence.

n1c18d0340c.headline: Trump threatens sanctions, tariffs on Mexico in water dispute
n1c18d0340c.summary: US President Donald Trump threatened Mexico with sanctions and tariffs over water sharing, accusing it of breaking an 81-year-old treaty. He said Mexico was stealing water from Texas farmers.
n1c18d0340c.why: Tariff threats against Mexico, a top US trading partner, can disrupt cross-border supply chains, agricultural trade and the peso.

n68f9876f33.headline: HMRC to demand 650,000 pensioners pay more tax from this week
n68f9876f33.summary: About 650,000 pensioners will pay more tax from this week because of a rule change, according to the Manchester Evening News. The change affects thousands of pensioners.
n68f9876f33.why: HMRC is the UK tax authority, and changes to thresholds and reliefs alter household disposable income and government revenue.

n6267b0df1a.headline: US Sanctions Iran’s Ghost Fleet and Chinese Oil Terminal Linked to Iranians
n6267b0df1a.summary: The US has sanctioned Iran's so-called ghost fleet of tankers and a Chinese oil terminal linked to Iranian interests. President Trump said Iran would be in 'great danger' if nuclear talks set for Oman failed.
n6267b0df1a.why: Sanctions on shadow tankers and terminals restrict Iranian crude exports and can tighten global oil supply, affecting benchmark crude prices.

na30e7e62b9.headline: European markets functioning well, ECB attentive to FX movements, Lagarde says
na30e7e62b9.summary: ECB President Christine Lagarde said euro zone financial markets are functioning well despite global turbulence. She said the ECB is ready to deploy its instruments to maintain financial stability if needed.
na30e7e62b9.why: The European Central Bank sets monetary policy for the euro area, and its comments on market stability and currency moves shape euro asset pricing.

n5b6c4da212.headline: Argentina says it will lift the country's strict currency controls with the help from the IMF
n5b6c4da212.summary: Argentina's economy minister said the government will lift strict capital and currency controls within days. The move is a high-stakes gamble made possible by IMF support, according to AP.
n5b6c4da212.why: Currency and capital controls restrict foreign exchange and capital flows, so lifting them directly affects the peso and foreign investors' access to Argentina.
n5b6c4da212.why_moved: The removal of strict capital and currency controls, backed by IMF support, changes the rules governing foreign exchange and capital flows in Argentina.

n364591812f.headline: Dozens of USAID contracts were canceled last weekend. Here's what happened
n364591812f.summary: Dozens of USAID contracts were canceled last weekend, with the rationale given as addressing mismanagement, fraud and misaligned priorities. Former official Jeremy Konyndyk said reversals created 'total whiplash'.
n364591812f.why: USAID is the US government's foreign aid agency, and its contracts flow to international development firms and NGOs, so cancellations affect those contractors.

ne9b8a46095.headline: S&P Global Ratings Raises Italy's Credit Rating
ne9b8a46095.summary: S&P Global Ratings upgraded its credit rating on Italy. The agency cited the US administration's decision to suspend a planned 20% tariff on European Union goods.
ne9b8a46095.why: Sovereign credit ratings influence borrowing costs for governments and the pricing of their bonds, which matters for fixed-income investors.

nef0249076a.headline: Equity investment in Indian real estate rises 74% in Q4 FY25:  CBRE
nef0249076a.summary: Equity investment in Indian real estate rose 74% in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025, according to CBRE. The figures were given by CBRE's India, South-East Asia, Middle East and Africa chief.
nef0249076a.why: CBRE is a global commercial real estate services firm, and its investment data is widely used to track capital flows into property markets.

n447b8ea599.headline: Fears over virus prompt European countries to shut borders
n447b8ea599.summary: Livestock are being slaughtered by the thousands in Hungary after its first foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in more than 50 years. Fears over the virus have prompted European countries to shut borders.
n447b8ea599.why: Foot-and-mouth disease is a highly contagious livestock disease, and outbreaks can trigger animal culls, export bans and losses for farmers and meat producers. Hungary is a notable livestock and meat producer in Europe.

n973a5f306c.headline: CBN's PMI rises to 52.3% March 2025
n973a5f306c.summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria's Purchasing Managers' Index rose to 52.3 index points in March, showing upward growth. A reading above 50 indicates expansion.
n973a5f306c.why: The PMI is a leading gauge of manufacturing and services activity, informing views on economic momentum and central bank policy.

n7d6f294847.headline: Nigeria to exit grey list soon-SEC
n7d6f294847.summary: Nigeria's Securities and Exchange Commission said the country may exit the grey list soon, with the inclusion of digital assets regulation cited as a factor. The statement was reported by Blueprint Newspapers.
n7d6f294847.why: The grey list is the Financial Action Task Force's watchlist for weak anti-money-laundering regimes, and removal can improve foreign investor and banking access. Digital asset rules are a key part of the regulatory framework.

n8bc595cfa2.headline: ONS finds construction returned to growth in February
n8bc595cfa2.summary: The Office for National Statistics found construction returned to growth in February. Better weather is credited with improving industry fortunes.
n8bc595cfa2.why: Construction output is a leading indicator of UK economic activity and is closely watched by the Bank of England. Weather-driven swings can distort monthly data.

nb20496e418.headline: Valvoline Inc. Receives Second Request from Federal Trade Commission Related to the Proposed Acquisition of Breeze Autocare
nb20496e418.summary: Valvoline and Greenbriar Equity Group each received a Federal Trade Commission Second Request related to Valvoline's proposed acquisition of Breeze Autocare. The request signals an extended antitrust review.
nb20496e418.why: Valvoline is a US automotive service and lubricants company. FTC second requests typically extend merger reviews and can delay or reshape deal timing.

nffb0f0ddd2.headline: Gold price surges to fresh all-time high as Trump trade war rattles markets
nffb0f0ddd2.summary: Gold prices surged to a fresh all-time high as the Trump trade war rattled markets. Analysts said the spike reflects investors seeking safe-haven assets.
nffb0f0ddd2.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that often attracts demand when trade tensions or economic uncertainty rise.

n8d27539f44.headline: Amid a chaotic stock market, the price of gold reaches historic high. What you should know
n8d27539f44.summary: Gold reached a historic high as an unstable stock market drove investors toward what is described as one of the most stable investments. The article outlines what investors should know.
n8d27539f44.why: Gold is widely held as a store of value and hedge during equity volatility. It trades mainly on COMEX in New York, and its price influences mining and central bank reserve decisions.

n04aae34d2b.headline: How Apple is airlifting tonnes of iPhones to avoid Trump's tariffs
n04aae34d2b.summary: Apple reportedly ordered cargo flights to transport 600 tonnes of iPhones from India to the US at the end of March. The move is reported as a way to avoid tariffs.
n04aae34d2b.why: Apple is one of the largest smartphone makers and sources a growing share of iPhone production from India, so tariff exposure affects its supply chain and costs.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Shifting iPhone shipments by air to avoid tariffs adds logistics costs while protecting US sales.

n3c7be42ba1.headline: Trump’s economic adviser dampens Starmer’s hopes of tariffs relief
n3c7be42ba1.summary: A senior economic adviser to Donald Trump said it would take an extraordinary deal for any country, including the UK, to improve on the 10% tariff. The comment dampens hopes of relief for Starmer.
n3c7be42ba1.why: Tariff terms set the cost of UK exports to the US, which affects UK exporters and sterling-linked assets.

nf5bfb205ab.headline: Waikato Tainui, Brookfield in billion-dollar Ruakura Superhub JV
nf5bfb205ab.summary: Waikato Tainui's commercial arm, Tainui Group Holdings, has entered a billion-dollar partnership with Brookfield Asset Management. The partnership will develop Hamilton's Ruakura Superhub.
nf5bfb205ab.why: Brookfield is a global alternative asset manager investing in infrastructure and property, and this deal is a major real estate and development partnership in New Zealand.

na39102da0e.headline: Why Broadcom Stock Jumped Today
na39102da0e.summary: Broadcom stock rebounded on Friday after sell-offs the previous day, according to Yahoo Finance.
na39102da0e.why: Broadcom is a major US semiconductor and infrastructure software company, and its share moves influence the tech sector and chip-related indexes.

impacts.name: Broadcom
impacts.why: The stock recovered after the prior day's declines.

nf3a67cd064.headline: Sensex  rises! These  stocks gained over 10% on BSE
nf3a67cd064.summary: The Sensex advanced, with 47 Nifty 50 stocks ending in the green and 3 closing in the red. Several stocks gained more than 10% on the BSE.
nf3a67cd064.why: The BSE Sensex is India's benchmark index of 30 large companies, and its moves reflect sentiment in Indian equities.
nf3a67cd064.why_moved: Broad gains were recorded, with 47 of the Nifty 50 stocks closing higher, though the source gives no specific cause.

n5d1656dd05.headline: Reserve Bank call for calm is welcome amid tariff drama
n5d1656dd05.summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers said Australia is still well placed to navigate economic uncertainty generated by US tariffs under Donald Trump. The comments follow a Reserve Bank call for calm.
n5d1656dd05.why: The Australian Treasury manages federal fiscal policy, and its outlook shapes expectations for growth, rates and the Australian dollar.

n3711adb506.headline: French Bikers Race to Buy Harleys before Possible Tariffs
n3711adb506.summary: Sales are brisk at a Harley-Davidson dealership outside Paris, as French buyers rush to purchase American motorcycles before possible trade-war tariffs.
n3711adb506.why: Harley-Davidson is a US motorcycle maker whose European sales depend on cross-border trade and pricing.

n798b00f5a8.headline: ‘There isn’t an hour to lose’ – Harris says tariff pause vital for negotiations - National News - Carlow Nationalist
n798b00f5a8.summary: Ireland's Tánaiste Harris said it is important to use US President Donald Trump's 90-day tariffs pause for negotiations. He said there is not an hour to lose.
n798b00f5a8.why: Ireland is an export-oriented economy with large pharmaceutical and technology exports to the US, so tariff policy directly affects its growth outlook. The 90-day pause defines the window for talks.

n0fe32a7cd1.headline: PSX recovers 2,036 points after tariff pause
n0fe32a7cd1.summary: Despite volatility from the ongoing tariff war, the Pakistan Stock Exchange staged a strong recovery of 2,036 points.
n0fe32a7cd1.why: The Pakistan Stock Exchange is the country's main equity market, and its index reflects broad investor sentiment toward Pakistani companies.
n0fe32a7cd1.why_moved: A pause in the tariff war eased concerns about trade disruption, prompting buying that lifted the index by 2,036 points.

nd3eed11938.headline: Asian shares sink, Japan’s Nikkei down as China-US trade war escalates
nd3eed11938.summary: Asian shares sank and Japan's Nikkei fell as the China-US trade war escalated, while the yen surged against the US dollar.
nd3eed11938.why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark index, and Japanese equities are sensitive to trade tensions because of their export exposure.
nd3eed11938.why_moved: Escalation of the China-US trade war sent Asian shares lower, with the Nikkei falling and the yen surging against the dollar.

n7bfda8919e.headline: Gas utilities seek massive increase  for FY26
n7bfda8919e.summary: SNGPL and SSGC have petitioned the regulator Ogra for increases of 42% and 144%, with public hearings set for April 18 and 21.
n7bfda8919e.why: Gas utilities set consumer tariffs under regulator oversight, and changes affect household costs, industrial energy prices and utility finances.

n4b55ff21ce.headline: Auto sales swell by 46pc in 9MFY25
n4b55ff21ce.summary: Pakistan's auto sales grew 46% in the first nine months of FY25, while two- and three-wheeler sales rose 34% year on year, reaching 125,311 units in March.
n4b55ff21ce.why: Vehicle sales are a key indicator of consumer demand and credit conditions in the auto sector.

n8a8f6123e2.headline: Uptick in SBP reserves
n8a8f6123e2.summary: Pakistan's overall foreign reserves stood at $15.752 billion for the week, including $5.053 billion held by commercial banks, according to the central bank.
n8a8f6123e2.why: Foreign exchange reserves indicate a country's capacity to pay for imports and service external debt, which matters for its currency and sovereign risk.

n3dfe137008.headline: Govt to seek fresh bids for PIA privatisation, says adviser
n3dfe137008.summary: The government will seek fresh bids to privatise Pakistan International Airlines and aims to complete the sale by year-end, an adviser said. Legacy debt was shifted to the government to attract buyers.
n3dfe137008.why: Privatisation sales determine how state-owned enterprises are funded and restructured, which matters for investors in emerging markets.

na827f8b6f9.headline: Bank advances to private sector fall
na827f8b6f9.summary: State Bank of Pakistan data shows the private sector repaid more bank money than it borrowed in the second quarter of FY25.
na827f8b6f9.why: Bank lending to businesses and households is a key gauge of credit demand and economic momentum in Pakistan's banking system.

n093afe8be2.headline: Vancouver mayor's bitcoin push a 'hill that I’m willing to die on'
n093afe8be2.summary: Vancouver Mayor Ken Sim said pursuing a city bitcoin initiative is a 'hill that I'm willing to die on', citing a fiduciary duty to do what is right for the city.
n093afe8be2.why: Municipal bitcoin holdings or payments would expose a city treasury to crypto price volatility and regulatory scrutiny.

n51fabbea83.headline: Danish shoppers boycott U.S. products as Greenland — and trade — tensions escalate
n51fabbea83.summary: Danish shoppers are turning away from American products amid President Trump's posturing over Greenland and sweeping trade tariffs.
n51fabbea83.why: Consumer boycotts can reduce demand for imported goods and add pressure on exporters already facing tariffs. Trade tensions between Denmark's allies and the US affect transatlantic commerce.

ned7cbb7591.headline: Biocon shares jump 5.5% as USFDA clears biosimilar Cancer drug JOBEVNE | Stock Market News
ned7cbb7591.summary: Biocon's shares rose 5.5% after the US FDA approved JOBEVNE, its seventh USFDA-approved biosimilar and an addition to its oncology portfolio.
ned7cbb7591.why: Biocon is an Indian biopharmaceutical company that develops generic and biosimilar medicines for global markets. US regulatory approvals open access to one of the largest drug markets.
ned7cbb7591.why_moved: The US FDA approval of JOBEVNE, Biocon's seventh US-approved biosimilar, strengthened its oncology portfolio and boosted investor confidence.

n43be84a2e3.headline: Australia’s most famous race track could get $15 million upgrade
n43be84a2e3.summary: Federal funding of $15 million is pledged for Mount Panorama's upgrade, potentially boosting local tourism and economy.
n43be84a2e3.why: Infrastructure investments in tourism sites can stimulate local economic activity and attract visitors.

n7a936b9729.headline: Australia’s most famous race track could get $15 million upgrade
n7a936b9729.summary: Federal funding of $15 million is allocated for the upgrade of Mount Panorama race track in Australia.
n7a936b9729.why: Infrastructure investments in major venues can stimulate local economies and attract events.

nb389cbb52c.headline: Philippines central bank chief signals cautious path on rate cuts
nb389cbb52c.summary: The Philippine central bank is adopting a cautious stance on policy easing to avoid inflationary pressures.
nb389cbb52c.why: Interest rate decisions influence borrowing costs, inflation, and currency stability in the Philippines.

n534e725283.headline: UAE: Investing in Abu Dhabi real estate? Hotspots, emerging opportunities in emirate
n534e725283.summary: Yas Island, Al Raha Beach, and Saadiyat Island are emerging as key luxury property investment areas in Abu Dhabi for Q1 2025.
n534e725283.why: Real estate trends in Abu Dhabi reflect economic growth and investor interest in luxury markets.

naf352f6bd0.headline: Mortgage borrowers urged to act now as cheap 3.89% rate disappears
naf352f6bd0.summary: A lender increased mortgage rates after earlier reductions, prompting borrowers to review their finances amid rising borrowing costs.
naf352f6bd0.why: Mortgage rate changes directly impact housing affordability, consumer spending, and the real estate market.
